Read the methodology and limits of comparison

Coverage is the original 15 energy-consuming countries plus Croatia, not a worldwide tourism ranking. Tourism measures use a 2024 baseline; airline activity uses 2023 and electricity rates use December 2025. Newer releases may exist. All source links and metric years remain in the CSV.

Arrivals count trips, not unique people. Overnight tourists, visitors including same-day trips, and accommodation arrivals are separate measures. The UK-labelled OECD series has a 2024 coverage break involving Great Britain. Comparisons of size are descriptive, not destination performance scores.

Travel receipts are current-USD balance-of-payments travel exports, excluding international passenger transport. They are not profit, total tourism economic contribution, domestic spending, or government revenue. Exchange rates affect comparisons. We do not divide receipts by arrivals because the populations and methods differ.

Seasonality uses monthly domestic and international accommodation nights from Eurostat. Bed places measure reported accommodation capacity; national size thresholds can exclude small providers. Inbound accommodation nights from OECD mix visitor surveys and accommodation surveys. These are not occupancy rates and cannot be combined into an occupancy estimate.

Air passengers are carried by nationally registered airlines on domestic and international routes. They are not inbound tourists, airport traffic, route availability, or a measure of local public transport. Attraction examples are illustrative heritage places, not popularity rankings or operating-status recommendations.

Resident survey coverage is limited to a verified Canadian national result. Missing values mean unavailable in this release, never zero. We do not infer resident views, local capacity or environmental impacts from visitor volumes or energy mix. Regional monthly counts, local transport use, housing data and representative resident surveys are still needed for local management.

Original energy data and tools are retained. Business electricity prices assume 1,000,000 kWh/year and are not hotel-specific tariffs. Domestic electricity generation mix is not consumed-electricity mix; “Other” includes nuclear. Sources are credited in each country brief and in the downloadable records.
